edits.after:
Inspect completed native task output with the built-in Read tool, paging through
the complete file when needed. Do not execute Python or shell summarizers to
inspect that output, and do not repeat the review. Preserve the complete actual
inventory and its verdicts; clipped output is not a complete inventory.

Scheduled runs keep the same source requirements within the selected workset.
Any direct `emails.list_by_thread` call, including fact sourcing or post-compose
verification, must name a canonical RFC root in `triage_workset`'s `selected`
roots. The broad Sent-search examples below are interactive guidance: do not run
`emails.search` or inspect another root during a scheduled tick. A message ID,
source reference or draft citation does not select that conversation. If required
corroboration lies outside the reservation, report the candidate and missing
evidence as deferred without issuing the forbidden RPC. Preserve queue order,
current holds and every evidence requirement; never guess or widen the scope.
